Name: Bloodblade
Description:
With a simple swipe of your hand, you conjure sharp blades of crystalized blood that are flung unto a target creature within reach. Make a ranged spell attack against it.

On a hit, they take 2d8 slashing damage and suffer 2 Bleed count, as the blades of glass cut and pierce at their body, causing considerable bleeding.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may perform an additional ranged spell attack against creatures within reach for each slot level above 1st.
